terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using DotToDotFreePrintables.com you agree to these terms. They are short and mostly common sense.
terms.free: You may download and print any puzzle on this site, in unlimited copies, for personal, family, homeschool, and classroom use. Teachers may print for their whole class, include pages in homework packets, and share printed copies with colleagues. Libraries, therapists, and youth groups may print for the children they work with. No attribution, sign-up, or payment is required.
terms.permission: You may not sell the puzzles, include them in paid products or bundles, upload the files to other websites or file-sharing services, remove the site branding, or claim them as your own. If you want to feature a puzzle somewhere — a blog, a book, an app — link to the puzzle's page on this site or ask us first. We say yes to most reasonable requests.
terms.purchasePolicy: Paid puzzle packs are digital PDF products delivered immediately after successful payment. Because a digital file cannot be returned after access begins, all sales are final and we do not offer returns, exchanges, or refunds for change of mind or accidental purchases. This policy does not limit any refund, cancellation, or withdrawal right that cannot legally be excluded where you live.
terms.purchaseHelp: If your download is not delivered, the file is defective, you are charged more than once, or the product is materially different from its description, email hellokidsbookworld@gmail.com with your purchase email and a description of the problem. We will provide a working replacement or an appropriate refund. By requesting immediate access at checkout, you consent to immediate delivery and acknowledge that any applicable withdrawal right may end once delivery begins.

terms.warranty: The site and its content are provided as is. We test every puzzle before publishing, but we make no warranties of any kind and are not liable for any damages arising from use of the site or its printables, to the maximum extent permitted by law. Adult supervision is recommended for young children using scissors or other tools alongside our activities.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information DotToDotFreePrintables.com collects when you visit, how it is used, and the choices you have. The short version: we do not require accounts, we do not sell personal information, and you can download every puzzle without giving us any personal data at all.
privacy.analytics: Analytics. We use Google Analytics 4 to understand how the site is used — pages visited, approximate location, device and browser type. Google Analytics sets cookies and collects identifiers for this purpose. This data is aggregated; we do not use it to identify individual visitors.
privacy.email: Email. If you email us, we receive your address and message. We use them only to reply and do not add you to any list.
privacy.forms: Forms and embeds. Some pages embed YouTube videos or Google Forms. If you interact with these, Google may process data under its own privacy policy.
privacy.notCollect: What we do not collect: no accounts, no passwords, no payment details, and no personal information is required to download or print any puzzle.
privacy.children: Our printables are made for children, but the website itself is directed at the adults who print them — parents, guardians, and teachers. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. The site has no accounts, comments, or chat. If you believe a child has sent us personal information by email, contact us and we will delete it.
privacy.ads: The site may display advertising to cover its costs. If advertising is active, ad providers may use cookies or similar technologies to show ads; where required, you will be asked for consent before any advertising cookies are set.
privacy.rights: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete personal data, and to object to or restrict its processing. Because we hold almost no personal data, exercising these rights is usually as simple as emailing us. We do not sell or share personal information.
privacy.security: Analytics data is retained per Google Analytics default settings. Emails are kept only as long as needed to handle your message. The site is served over HTTPS.
privacy.changes: If this policy changes materially, the effective date above will be updated. Questions or requests: hellokidsbookworld@gmail.com or via the contact page.

about.title: About DotToDotFreePrintables
about.intro: DotToDotFreePrintables.com does one thing: free printable connect-the-dots worksheets for kids. No accounts, no subscriptions, no paywalls — every puzzle on this site can be downloaded as a print-ready PDF and used at home, in a homeschool, or in a classroom.
about.made: Every puzzle is designed in-house, printed on paper, and tested with real children before it is published. If a dot cluster confuses kids, or a line crosses awkwardly, the page is revised until it works. Puzzles are organized by theme and by difficulty — from 10-dot pages for toddlers up to 100+ dot challenges for older kids — so there is a right level for almost every child.
about.guides: Our guides and articles are written under the pen name Mira. Mira designs, prints, and child-tests every puzzle on this site before it is published, and the parent and teacher guides here come from watching real kids work through the pages.
about.free: Printable activities are one of the simplest screen-free tools families and teachers have, and we think the basic version of that should cost nothing. The site may show advertising to cover its costs, but the puzzles themselves are free and will stay free — no sign-up required.
about.contact: Puzzle requests, corrections, or questions are always welcome — see the contact page. You can also read our privacy policy and terms of use.
